name: event-driven-architecture
description: Self-service developer workshop on OpenShift featuring Kafka CDC, Developer Hub, ArgoCD GitOps, and software templates.
products: Red Hat Streams for Apache Kafka

full.description: All components enabled — AI/ML, Service Mesh, Observability, DevSpaces, BPM, Industrial Edge. Matches GitHub Pages and Showroom labs.

estimatedResources.recommendedWorkers: 3 nodes x 64 vCPU / 128 Gi (or 4 x m5.8xlarge 32 vCPU / 128 Gi). Do not treat m5.8xlarge as 64 vCPU.

lite.description: Core EDA workshop only — Kafka CDC, Developer Hub, Keycloak, Gitea, Mailpit. No AI/ML, DevSpaces, Service Mesh, Observability, or NeuroFace. RHDP does not load this overlay unless you pass it as a Helm valueFile.

estimatedResources.recommendedWorkers: 3 nodes x 32 vCPU / 64 Gi (3 x m5.4xlarge is tight; prefer 3 x 32/64)
